name: cursor-trail-ribbon
title: Cursor Trail Ribbon
description: A fading ribbon that follows the pointer as a polyline of recent positions rendered on canvas with quadratic smoothing — width and opacity taper along the trail's age, decaying to nothing when the pointer stops.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Pointer History: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
